info.title: PSAPI Programsider TV
info.description: PSAPI Programsider TV is an API that provides metadata about the NRK TV catalog.

tags.name: Series
tags.description: Series, series types and extra material.

get.summary: Gets the program page for a program.
get.description:
Gets the program page for the specified program.

Some examples to try:

* KOIF75001319 (Semester, 1. episode) 
* MSUB15200119 (Lik meg, 1. episode) 
* NNFA19052319 (Dagsrevyen, 23. mai 2019), 
* KOID75000219 (Bigbang - Play Louder)

parameters.name: programId
parameters.description: The 12-character 'ProgID' for a program. For backwards compatibility reasons we also currently support 16-character ID which consists of the ProgId with a suffix indicating accessibility version. In that case the suffix is ignored, and the program page indicated by the plain ProgId is returned.

get.summary: Gets navigation aid for a program.
get.description:
Gets some context to a programId. It is meant to be used to help clients with context to a programId that they are missing, possibly because we are moving from old seriespages to new seriespages.

Some examples to try:

* KOIF75001319 (Semester, 1. episode)
* MSUB15200119 (Lik meg, 1. episode)
* NNFA19052319 (Dagsrevyen, 23. mai 2019)
* KOID75000219 (Bigbang - Play Louder)

parameters.name: programId
parameters.description: The 12-character 'ProgID' for a program. For backwards compatibility reasons we also currently support 16-character ID which consists of the ProgId with a suffix indicating accessibility version.

get.summary: Gets navigation aid for a offline program.
get.description: Gets some offline context to a programId. It is meant to be used to help clients with context to a programId that they are missing when they want to make a program offline, for example a static title.

parameters.name: programId
parameters.description: The 12-character 'ProgID' for a program. For backwards compatibility reasons we also currently support 16-character ID which consists of the ProgId with a suffix indicating accessibility version.

get.description:
Gets the TV series indicated by the provided URL-friendly series ID. Series come in three types: sequential, standard and news.

Some examples to try out:

* sequential: heimebane, skam, 113
* standard: lindmo, trygdekontoret, stroemmeland
* news: dagsrevyen, debatten, urix

parameters.description: This parameter only affects standard and news series. Default is 10.
parameters.name: embeddedInstalmentsPageSize

get.description: Gets extramaterials for TV series, such as trailers and marathon episodes.

get.summary: Gets a collection of instalments for a TV series.
get.description: Gets a collection of instalments for a TV series. The results are paged.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Specifies the page size for the results. Default page size is 10.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Indicates start page for paged results. Default is to start at page 1.

get.summary: Gets a season for a TV series.
get.description: Gets the specified season for the specified TV series.

parameters.name: seasonId
parameters.description: The ID for a season. For sequential series, it is a number. For other series, it is a string.

get.summary: Gets the type of a specific TV series.
get.description:
Gets the type of TV series for the provided URL-friendly series ID. Series come in three types: sequential, standard and news.

Some examples to try out:

* heimebane (sequential)
* trygdekontoret (standard)
* dagsrevyen (news)

ForbiddenContent.description: The content is not appropriate for the given content group.

UnavailableContent.description: The content is not available for the given content group.

ContentGroup.name: contentGroup
ContentGroup.description: Optionally provide the users content group. Restricts access to content marked as appropriate for this content group. Attempted access of non-appropriate content will be forbidden.

AgeRestriction.name: ageRestriction
AgeRestriction.description: Optionally provide an age restriction. Used when determining if access to a rated program is allowed. When provided, `ageRestriction.access` will be determined based on the given age restriction.

ContentGroup.description: Divides content into groups appropriate for different users. Currently the values adults and children are used, but this could change in the future.

type.description: Type of badge that should be shown on an episode

accessibilityValue.description: Accessbility value based on badge type.

Availability.description: Represents the availability of a program based on the active usage rights.

hasLabel.description: Label should only be displayed if HasLabel is true.

label.description: Label to be showed to the user based on the AvailabilityStatus.

ReleaseDateOnDemand.description: The first time the program was made available on demand (based on the earliest usage right).

Duration.description: Duration of the program. We use the [ISO-8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601#Durations) format for duration.

GoogleAnalyticsVmForSeries.description: Google analytics object with one or several dimensions for series. See documentation on https://github.com/nrkno/analytics-docs/blob/master/docs/schema.md

dimension21.description: Seriens url_friendly_id i Granitt. Kun relevant for episoder/instalments.

ProgressesHalLink.description: ProgressHalLink consists of a list of comma-separated programIds that we gzip, base64 and url encode to avoid exceeding character limit in the url.

ExternalHalLinks.description: **Experimental:** Collection of links to external content. Ordered by relevance.

href.description: Absolute URL to the external content.

icon.description: Optional reference to an icon that can be displayed alongside the link title.

NavigationLinks.description: Links to related content, usually found in other NRK products like NRK Radio or nrk.no

subtitle.description: Subtitle or additional description of the link.

icon.description: Optional icon that can be displayed alongside the link.

image.description: Optional field to indicate an image associated with the link.

NavigationLinkTarget.description: Information about the target of the link. Targets may be of different types, depending on the kind of content being linked. Clients should ignore links with an unknown target type.

url.description: Absolute URL to the linked content.
